# LogoMakr

> LogoMakr is a comprehensive logo design platform combining AI-powered generation, customizable templates, and manual editing tools for creating professional brand identities.

LogoMakr offers multiple pathways for logo creation, from AI-assisted design to guided workflows and blank canvas editing. The platform supports multiple export formats (SVG, PDF, PNG) and caters to both beginners and experienced designers seeking original logo designs.

## Key Topics

- AI Logo Generator
- Logo Creation Methods
- Blank Canvas Editor
- Logo Templates
- Guided Mode
- Prompt Mode
- Original Logo Design
- Vector File Export
- SVG/PDF/PNG Export
- Logo Customization
- Brand Design Tool
- AI Branding

## AI Logo Generation

- [Free AI Logo Generator](https://logomakr.com/ai-logo-generator): AI-powered logo generator creating original designs with SVG, PDF, PNG export capabilities.

## Getting Started

- [Choose Your Path](https://logomakr.com/choose-your-path): Guide to LogoMakr's logo creation methods: AI Generator, Templates, Guided Mode, Blank Canvas.
